---
title: "Career Evaluation in Software Publishing"
subtitle: "Data science and adjacent AI and ML roles in 2024"
---

Our Group 10 product uses ten audited U.S. job postings from May–September 2024 in Software Publishers, NAICS 513210, to connect market evidence with a student's career decisions.

**Our recommendation:** use analytics and data roles as the nearer-term search direction, while building the Machine Learning, MLOps, and cloud evidence needed for longer-term AI and ML roles. The sample is senior-oriented, so this is a skill-development strategy rather than a claim of entry-level availability.

| Evidence | What the product shows |
|---|---|
| Market baseline | 10 postings, 7 usable salaries, and 2 explicitly remote roles |
| Skill gaps | Machine Learning and MLOps remain priorities across skill sources |
| Final analytics | A six/four segmentation, with a 0.291 silhouette and documented model-selection checks |
| Career decision | A staged search and portfolio plan with limits stated |
